title: Easy Fall Dinner Recipes That Bring Cozy Comfort to Your Weeknight Table
promptIMG: Food photography: easy fall dinner recipes, appetizing presentation, natural lighting, kitchen setting, documentary style, realistic colors --ar 4:3 --quality 2

image_prompts.img1: SCENE: a warmly lit home kitchen softly blurred behind with a bright window casting natural daylight. SUBJECT: a generous, overflowing ceramic casserole dish filled with a layered autumn vegetable bake featuring roasted butternut squash, caramelized onions, and browned melted cheese on top. The front corner piece is razor-sharp at a 30-degree angle, showcasing the crispy golden edges and gooey cheese pull. DETAILS: deep caramelized glaze on squash, glossy melted cheese with herbs sprinkled, natural crumbs scattered on the dish edge. STYLE: ultra-photorealistic professional food photography with bright airy daylight and warm golden hues, rich saturated colors evoking fall warmth. AVOID: no text, no hands, no people, no dull or washed-out colors, no steam or smoke.
image_prompts.img2: SCENE: soft light blur background of warm wood and marble tones with bright clean daylight. SUBJECT: the reveal shot of a hearty fall stew bowl cut open to show tender chunks of slow-cooked beef, glistening root vegetables, and rich gravy slowly dripping from a spoon resting mid-scoop. DETAILS: glossy wet interior with vibrant orange carrots and deep brown broth, fresh thyme garnish on top, crumbs and a light dusting of pepper scattered below. STYLE: ultra-photorealistic professional food photography with warm golden-amber tones, shallow macro depth of field, hyper-vivid colors. AVOID: no text, no hands, no people, no CGI or plastic textures.
image_prompts.img3: SCENE: warm dark wood softly blurred behind with a single warm side glow highlighting the dish. SUBJECT: several slices of a rustic pumpkin and sage lasagna stacked close together on a wooden board, topped with melted mozzarella and fresh sage leaves. The front slice is razor-sharp with a generous cheese pull and visible layers of creamy pumpkin sauce and pasta. DETAILS: intense glossy shine on cheese, deep amber caramelization on edges, scattered sage leaves and a light dusting of nutmeg. STYLE: ultra-photorealistic professional food photography with deep golden-amber warmth, rich saturated tones, shallow macro depth of field. AVOID: no text, no hands, no people, no dull colors, no steam.
